questions.q: What is the three-step path to any object's settings?
options: Setup → Object Manager → the object itself
Reports → Dashboards → Object Manager
App Launcher → Chatter → Setup
Object Manager → Setup → Schema Builder
questions.explain: The gear icon opens Setup, Object Manager lists every object, and clicking an object opens its own settings.

questions.q: Where does Object Manager sit, relative to Setup Home?
options: It doesn't exist in Lightning Experience
Only inside the Reports tab
It can only be reached through the App Launcher
Right next to Home, at the top of Setup
questions.explain: Object Manager is positioned right next to Home at the top of the Setup page, one click away.

questions.q: Does the settings rail (Fields & Relationships, Page Layouts, Record Types, etc.) differ between a standard object and a custom object?
options: Yes, custom objects have a completely different settings rail
No, the same rail of sections appears for every object, standard or custom
Custom objects have no settings rail at all
Only Record Types differs between object types
questions.explain: The settings rail is identical across every object — learning it on one object (like Account) means you can navigate any object's settings.

questions.q: Besides field-level settings, what else can you edit from Object Manager's own list?
options: Nothing — Object Manager's list is read-only
Only the org's overall security settings
Object-level settings, such as its label and description, via the row's Edit command
The Salesforce release version
questions.explain: Each row in Object Manager's list has its own Edit command for object-level settings, separate from the field-level settings inside the object.

questions.q: Which section of an object's settings rail controls different field sets or picklist values for different business processes?
options: Search Layouts
Record Types
Buttons, Links, and Actions
Lightning Record Pages
questions.explain: Record Types let the same object support different business processes with different available picklist values and page layouts.
